title: 第12章 鄂珑点名第13章 丹成女疯子
content_zh:
《万木丹心诀》这部功法不仅对炼丹有帮助，更重要的是，它能提升他对草木之气的感知，让徐长生在处理药材时事半功倍。
而且，修炼这部功法，不需要消耗大量的灵气，不会影响他日常的修行。
徐长生闭上眼，开始按照《万木丹心诀》的心法运转体内灵气。
这一运转，他顿时察觉到了不同。
《青木长生诀》是将灵气纳入丹田，壮大自身。
而《万木丹心诀》，则是将灵气引导至心脉，在心口处凝聚一团青色的光晕。
那光晕，便是丹心的雏形。
随着灵气的不断注入，那团光晕渐渐凝实，散发出一种温润而柔和的光芒。
徐长生能清晰地感觉到，自己对周围草木之气的感知，正在以一种惊人的速度提升。
他甚至能“看到”，窗外那棵老槐树根部，一缕缕微弱的木灵气，正缓缓向上升腾。
“这就是丹心的力量？”
徐长生心中惊叹，继续运转功法。
徐长生以往听人提起过，“剑心”，那是剑道修士凝聚在“丹田”的力量之源，可他的丹心，却和剑心所处的位置不太一样。
不过，徐长生也不以为意，只当是功法特殊，所造成的结果罢了。
不知不觉，一夜过去了。
天亮时，徐长生睁开眼，眸中闪过一丝青色光芒。
他站起身，活动了一下筋骨，只觉得神清气爽，比睡了一觉还要精神。
更重要的是，他心口处那团丹心雏形，已经稳定了下来。
“试试效果。”
徐长生推门而出，走到东侧厢房，开始处理今天的药材。

拿起一株月见草，他顿时感觉到了不同。
以往，他只能凭经验判断这株药材的处理方式。
但现在，他能清晰地“感知”到，这株月见草内部的灵气分布——哪里的药性最浓，哪里需要保留，哪里可以舍弃，一目了然。
他甚至能察觉到，这株月见草是在采摘后的第二天，距离药性流失还有一天的时间。
“不可思议……”
徐长生喃喃自语，手中的动作却丝毫不慢。
他按照感知到的最佳方式，处理完这株月见草，整个过程行云流水，比以往快了不止一倍。
而且，处理出来的药材，品质明显更高。
“徐长生，你今天怎么这么快？”
怀来走进厢房，看到他面前已经处理好的十几株药材，惊讶地瞪大了眼。
徐长生笑了笑，“可能今天状态好吧。”
怀来将信将疑地看着他，又看了看那些药材，啧啧称奇，“这品质……都快赶上云长老亲手处理的了。你小子，不会藏了什么绝活吧？”
徐长生摇摇头，没有多说什么。
怀来也没有追问，只是拍了拍他的肩膀，笑道：“行啊，有你这手艺，咱们以后的日子能好过不少。”
两人说说笑笑，继续干活。
日子一天天过去，徐长生在炼丹房的日子，渐渐安稳下来。
云长老果然如怀来所说，大部分时间都泡在丹房里钻研炼丹术，对他们这些杂役不太管理，只要活儿干好了，从不过问。
这让徐长生有了大量的时间，可以暗中修炼《青木长生诀》和《万木丹心诀》。
白天处理药材，晚上修行功法。
日子虽然清苦，却过得充实而踏实。

“轰”
这一夜，徐长生再次吞下一颗极品聚气丹，在药力的冲击下，他体内丹田灵气疯狂滋长，瞬间冲破了练气四层的瓶颈，突破到了练气五层！
content_en:
The "Wanmu Danxin Jue" technique is not only helpful for refining elixirs, but more importantly, it can improve his perception of the aura of vegetation, allowing Xu Changsheng to get twice the result with half the effort when handling medicinal materials.
Moreover, practicing this technique does not require the consumption of a large amount of spiritual energy and will not affect his daily practice.
Xu Changsheng closed his eyes and began to circulate the spiritual energy in his body according to the mental method of "Wan Mu Dan Heart Jue".
With this movement, he immediately noticed a difference.
"Aoki Immortality Technique" is to incorporate spiritual energy into the Dantian to strengthen oneself.
The "Wan Mu Dan Heart Technique" guides the spiritual energy to the heart veins and condenses a blue halo at the heart.
That halo is the prototype of Danxin.
With the continuous injection of spiritual energy, the halo gradually solidified, emitting a warm and soft light.
Xu Changsheng could clearly feel that his perception of the aura of the surrounding vegetation was improving at an alarming rate.
He could even "see" wisps of weak wood spirit energy rising slowly upward from the roots of the old locust tree outside the window.
"Is this the power of loyalty?"
Xu Changsheng marveled in his heart and continued to operate the technique.
Xu Changsheng had heard people mention it in the past, "Sword Heart", which was the source of power that kendo monks gathered in their "Dantian", but his Danxin was in a different position from that of Sword Heart.
However, Xu Changsheng didn't take it seriously and regarded it as the result of the special technique.
Before I knew it, the night passed.
At dawn, Xu Changsheng opened his eyes, and a trace of cyan light flashed in his eyes.
He stood up and stretched his muscles. He felt refreshed and more energetic than after sleeping.
More importantly, the embryonic form of loyalty in his heart has stabilized.
"Try the effect."
Xu Changsheng pushed open the door and walked to the east side room to start processing today's medicinal materials.
Picking up an evening primrose, he immediately felt a difference.
In the past, he could only judge how to handle this medicinal plant based on experience.
But now, he can clearly "perceive" the distribution of spiritual energy inside this evening primrose - where the medicinal properties are the strongest, where they need to be retained, and where they can be discarded, all at a glance.
He could even detect that this evening primrose was picked the day after it was picked, and there was still one day left before the medicinal properties would be lost.
"Incredible..."
Xu Changsheng murmured to himself, but the movements of his hands were not slow at all.
He processed the evening primrose in the best way he felt. The whole process went smoothly and was more than twice as fast as before.
Moreover, the quality of the processed medicinal materials is obviously higher.
"Xu Changsheng, why are you so fast today?"
Huailai walked into the side room and saw a dozen medicinal herbs that had been processed in front of him, and his eyes widened in surprise.
Xu Changsheng smiled and said, "Maybe I'm in good condition today."
Huailai looked at him suspiciously, then looked at the medicinal materials, and marveled, "This quality... is almost as good as the ones handled by Elder Yun himself. You kid, you don't have any special skills hidden, do you?"
Xu Changsheng shook his head and said nothing more.
Huailai didn't ask any questions, just patted him on the shoulder and said with a smile: "Okay, with your skills, our life will be much easier in the future."
The two chatted and laughed and continued working.
As the days passed, Xu Changsheng's days in the alchemy room gradually became stable.
As Huailai said, Elder Yun spent most of his time in the alchemy room studying alchemy. He didn't care much about the handymen like them. As long as the work was done well, he never asked questions.
This gave Xu Changsheng a lot of time to secretly practice the "Qingmu Immortality Technique" and "Wanmu Danxin Jue".
Processing medicinal materials during the day and practicing exercises at night.
Although life was hard, it was fulfilling and practical.
"Boom"
That night, Xu Changsheng once again swallowed a top-grade Qi Gathering Pill. Under the impact of the medicine, the spiritual energy in his body's Dantian grew crazily, instantly breaking through the bottleneck of the fourth level of Qi training and reaching the fifth level of Qi training!
